strategy.summary: Return the ball to the numbered top lanes, raise and collect the AE value through B-A-L-L, and pursue Bonus X only after the base bonus is large.

quickInfo.name: Numbers 1-10
quickInfo.summary: Top lanes can score one or two needed numbers, and the ten center star rollovers score one number each.

quickInfo.name: AE value
quickInfo.summary: Each completed set of ten numbers raises the AE value by 10K, from 10K to a maximum of 60K.

quickInfo.name: B-A-L-L
quickInfo.summary: Complete the upper-right B-A-L-L drop targets to collect the current AE value.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: The left bullseye or upper-right saucer advances Bonus X through 2x, 3x, and 5x.

quickInfo.name: Lit spinners
quickInfo.summary: After Bonus X reaches 5x, one more multiplier shot lights the spinners for 1K per spin.

steps.text: Plunge for a numbered top lane that you still need.
Repeat the two orbit shots to return the ball to the top lanes.
Complete numbers 1-10 to raise the AE value by 10K.
After the AE value is useful, complete B-A-L-L to collect it.
Build the base bonus through top returns, outlanes, the left standup, and B-A-L-L.
When the base bonus is large, shoot the safer Bonus X feature to reach 5x.
Make one more Bonus X shot to light the spinners, then repeat the safer spinner.

fallback.title: Opposite-orbit route
fallback.when: Use this when one orbit return or one lower-flipper shot is unreliable.

steps.text: Use the orbit that reaches the top with the safer return.
Nudge toward a missing numbered lane because the game has no lane change.
Let bumper action collect incidental B-A-L-L and saucer progress.
Stop using the orbit if its top exit begins to feed an outlane.

alternatives.title: High AE collect
alternatives.when: Use this when the AE value is near 60K and B-A-L-L targets are safe.

steps.text: Complete sets of ten numbers to raise the AE value.
Move the ball to the flipper that has the cleanest B-A-L-L angle.
Complete B-A-L-L to collect the current AE value.
Return to the top lanes instead of attacking L-A-S-E-R.
Complete the ten numbers five times to raise AE from 10K to 60K.
Complete B-A-L-L to collect the maximum AE value.
Score top and return lanes, outlanes, the left standup, and B-A-L-L targets until base bonus reaches 29K.
Shoot the left bullseye or upper-right saucer until Bonus X reaches 5x for a possible 145K end-of-ball bonus.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Williams Laser Ball and the installed L-2 ROM, then read ball-count, Bonus X, Extra Ball, Special, and replay settings.
Verify numbered lanes, center stars, B-A-L-L, AE lamps, Bonus X shots, spinner lamps, and bonus carry behavior.
Test both orbit returns, upper-right flipper deflections, bank rebounds, bumper exits, tilt sensitivity, and lower-flipper strength.

techniques.name: Needed-number plunge
techniques.instruction: Aim the plunge at a top lane with a missing number. Do not let the ball continue down the right orbit.

techniques.name: Upper-right flipper deflection
techniques.instruction: When possible, hold the upper-right flipper up and let the ball deflect safely. Do not make an unnecessary shot.

cautions.issue: Balls leaving the top can enter the slingshots, outlane dividers, or center drain.
cautions.response: Watch one complete top exit before you repeat an orbit. Nudge before the ball reaches a divider.

cautions.issue: L-A-S-E-R targets and center star rollovers can reject toward the center or right drain.
cautions.response: Use orbit play for number progress. Take these targets only from a controlled and proven angle.

cautions.issue: Shots from the lower-right flipper often miss more than shots from the other flippers.
cautions.response: Move the ball to the lower-left flipper when possible. Do not force a weak lower-right shot.

strategy.simpleOverview: Laser Ball uses numbered top lanes and star rollovers to raise an A-E value, then B-A-L-L collects it. Return upstairs until all ten numbers have been completed five times, finish B-A-L-L for the 60K collect, and work on Bonus X only after base bonus is large.
strategy.overview: Laser Ball uses numbered top lanes and star rollovers to raise an A-E value, then B-A-L-L collects it. Repeat safe upper feeds until A-E reaches 60K, then complete B-A-L-L. Build 29K base before advancing to 5x, and take one more multiplier shot for lit 1K spinners only after the bonus is secure.
